rules.statement: An action for damages arising from the breach of a lease agreement is barred by a previous judgment in an action to recover arrears of rent and cancel the lease, if the plaintiff could have included all claims within the first suit.
rules.supporting_quote: "That section does not say that every suit shall include every cause of action or every claim which a party has, but every suit shall include the whole of the claim arising out of the cause of action meaning the cause of action for which the suit is brought."
